label: Towing range collapse not disclosed alongside towing capacity
description: Manufacturers prominently advertise towing capacity (e.g., '10,000 lb tow rating') but rarely disclose that towing a substantial trailer reduces range by 40–60%. The two numbers are presented as if independent, when in fact a buyer who tows is operating in a fundamentally different range envelope.
regulatory_basis: SAE J2807 standardizes towing-capacity test methodology, but it does not require disclosure of efficiency or range under towing load. EPA range testing is unloaded.
consumer_harm: Buyers purchase EV trucks for towing duty (boats, campers, work trailers) and discover that real towing range is ~100–150 miles per charge — well below the unloaded EPA figure they used to plan purchases.
